Return of the Obra Dinn: deduce what happened on a ghost ship, 1-bit visuals, logic puzzles

What Remains of Edith Finch: walk through a family home, short vignettes, no fail state, melancholy
Doom Eternal: fast first-person shooter, aggressive movement, heavy metal, demon combat
Slay the Spire: deckbuilding roguelike, climb a tower, card synergies, turn-based
Stardew Valley: inherit a farm, grow crops, befriend villagers, relaxed pace, pixel art
Hades: roguelike dungeon crawler, Greek myth, isometric action, narrative between runs
Hollow Knight: explore a ruined insect kingdom, precise 2D combat, hand-drawn art, punishing difficulty
Into the Breach: turn-based tactics, tiny grid, perfect information, defend cities from bugs
Subnautica: underwater survival, alien ocean, crafting, genuine thalassophobia
Papers Please: immigration inspector, document checking, moral compromise, grim tone
Disco Elysium: detective RPG, no combat, dialogue driven, unreliable narrator, painted visuals
